chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight Places.
chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely systematic cosmological teaching: an eightfold ‘places wherein it is’ enumeration locating the living fire across Light-land, Father, First Man/Perfect Man, the two light ships, Living Spirit’s body, and the new earth. The only clear later material is the dialogue/frame attribution ‘Once again the apostle speaks’ in ¶1; otherwise the voice stays impersonal and intra-cosmic, with no institutional application and no NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: The [holy] living f[ire] is present i[n] eight places.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: “Once again the apostle speaks:” (Layer-2 hagiographic container using ‘apostle’).
paragraphs.temporal_note: The colon-introduced thesis fits the chapter’s enumerative teaching; the prefixed speaker-attribution ‘Once again the apostle speaks’ is a classic compiled-frame marker and must be stripped from the core.

paragraphs.core_text: The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it ... ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and ba]sis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure eightfold structure (‘first place’) with entirely intra-cosmic locations (light land, beyond the totality) and degree-language (‘foundation…basis…consideration’). No audience address or external institutional referents.

paragraphs.core_text: The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological placement (‘second place’) within the Father/emanation schema; explanatory mechanics (‘came…were revealed…came with them’) remain within the cosmological system.

paragraphs.core_text: The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o ... ... ] armour. Again, it is this fire [ ... ... ] on the body of the Perfect Man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative ‘third place’ locating the element on archetypal cosmic bodies (First Man, Perfect Man). Even with lacunae, the mapping is cosmos→cosmos (armour/body).

paragraphs.core_text: [The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic geography and purification mechanics (‘outer wall’, ‘ship of the day’) continue the intra-cosmic list without editorial application.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [ ... ] within the water.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief but structurally consistent (‘fifth’) and fully cosmological (‘light-giver of the night’, ‘within the water’).

paragraphs.core_text: [The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Although more narrative, it remains a cosmological process account (Living Spirit, summons/obedience, Porter) describing what the fire does/where it is in the cosmic economy—no pivot to contemporary practice.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [ ... ... ] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [ ... ] in it, in the [ ... ] whole [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Intra-cosmic architectural correspondences (‘new earth’, ‘foundation’, ‘course’, ‘crown’) and spatial relations (‘below the totality’) mark the impersonal substrate style.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [ ... ... ] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [ ... ] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still within the enumerative cosmology (‘eighth’) and tied back to cosmic vessels (‘two light ships’). ‘Person’ is ambiguous in the lacuna, but no institutional or exhortative anchoring appears.

paragraphs.core_text: This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].
paragraphs.temporal_note: A summarizing closure to the eightfold schema. It lacks explicit hagiographic/praise formulae; likely part of the teaching unit, though it could also be an editor’s tidy concluding line.
